sections.h2: Frequently Asked Questions — Social Media Marketing Company Kochi

items.q: Which social media platforms do you manage?
items.a: We manage Instagram marketing services Kochi, Facebook marketing services Kochi, and LinkedIn marketing services, with strategy adapted to each platform's audience and content style rather than a one-size-fits-all approach.

items.q: Do you create video content, or just static posts?
items.a: Both. Reels and video content services are a core part of our content mix, since video consistently gets stronger reach and engagement across most platforms today.

items.q: How often will our page be posted to?
items.a: Posting frequency is set during strategy planning based on your goals and resources, though consistency matters more than sheer volume — a realistic, sustainable schedule outperforms sporadic bursts.

items.q: Do you handle paid social ads as well as organic content?
items.a: Yes. Paid social advertising services are used to extend reach for content and campaigns, complementing organic posting rather than replacing it entirely.

items.q: How do you measure whether social media marketing is working?
items.a: Social media analytics and reporting tracks engagement, reach, and follower growth against your actual business goals, not just raw numbers disconnected from real outcomes.

items.q: Can you manage our page if we already have some existing content and followers?
items.a: Yes — we assess existing pages during the strategy audit and build on what's already working rather than starting from zero, adjusting the approach based on current performance and audience response.
